name: bucket-activity-console-error
goal: Normal bucket-backed console browsing loads recorded activity without a browser 404

evidence: A normal bucket-backed console must load recorded activity without a browser 404. consoleObjects excluded activity.json even though the installed console reads it.

test/console-object-activity.test.ts failed: history/activity.json was absent. The unchanged console-storage browser flow failed with a 404 for /harness/data/activity.json; before screenshot is from the same manual local fixture.
Included activity.json in the bucket upload whitelist while preserving the exclusion of unrelated files. Kept the browser error assertion enabled.

The unchanged unit regression and all 5 console-storage tests passed. The same local fixture now returns HTTP 200 for activity.json and shows repository demo after reload; before/after screenshots inspected.
